exposure: Women with urinary incontinence and spontaneous delivery
Women without urinary incontinence and with spontaneous delivery
Women without urinary incontinence and with cesarean section
Women with urinary incontinence and cesarean section
cohort: 83,066 women who delivered between 2004 and 2013, from the Korean National Health Insurance Service-National Sample Cohort
finding: Women with both urinary incontinence and cesarean section delivery had a significantly higher risk of postpartum depression compared to women without urinary incontinence and with spontaneous delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was significantly associated with postpartum depression during the first six months after childbirth.
